name: What is the difference between polished and honed marble for a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between polished and honed marble for a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main difference between polished and honed marble lies in their finish and appearance. Polished marble has a glossy, reflective surface that enhances its natural colors and veining, creating a luxurious look. It is less porous but can be more slippery when wet and shows etching more readily. Honed marble has a matte, satin finish that is less reflective. It offers better slip resistance, which is often preferred for bathroom floors, and tends to hide scratches and etching better, though it is slightly more porous and requires consistent sealing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Polished marble is glossy and reflective but can be slippery, while honed marble has a matte finish, offers better slip resistance, and hides imperfections more readily.
